obligation: F-04 /cases/165 and format matrix line 9 require distinct XLSX-to-CSV and ODS-to-CSV routes with value fidelity and disclosed losses.

xlsx_to_csv.oracle: Independent OOXML and original TSV check identified six inline strings. Strict CSV decoding and exact byte comparison preserved all six, including the string numeral.

ods_to_csv.oracle: Independent ODS XML and CSV parsing confirmed leading zeros, all 18 identifier digits, exact decimal and ISO date strings, and the literal formula-looking comment in a single quoted field.

common_observations.codec: UTF-8 without BOM, comma separator, LF
losses: CSV carries scalar text without native cell types, workbook or sheet metadata.
Cell and number/date display formatting are lost.
Spreadsheet applications' CSV import heuristics can change how identifiers or formula-looking text are interpreted. Office import was not exercised.

acceptance: Ordinary delivery, corresponding recipient loss disclosure and formal acceptance remain open for these directed cases. The previously completed TSV/CSV sends, prior S15 evaluations and historical closures remained unchanged.
